metadata.description: Conductor: an Opus-led orchestration skill that briefs, plans and routes work to Haiku, Sonnet and Opus workers, plus the agent-ledger mod that shows which agent ran on which model and what it used.

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Orchestration skill: rewrites your prompt as a technical brief, plans task cards, picks skills, agent and model per card, verifies and reports.

plugins.name: agent-ledger
plugins.description: Mod: /agents pane with every agent, its model, status, tokens and cache share; last turn's tokens by model above the prompt.

plugins.name: conductor-lint
plugins.description: Conductor plus a lint layer: ESLint, line budgets per card, worker efficiency rules, agent-lint reports and one fix round.

plugins.name: agent-lint
plugins.description: Mod: ESLint for agent work. Reports what each worker left behind (TODOs, stubs, skipped tests, out-of-scope files, open issues, ESLint, line budget) to the conductor; /leftovers pane.
